patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts frequently pair large, impactful imagery or illustrations with concise text blocks, often with a distinct background color for each section.
A custom, bold, rounded display typeface is used for all primary headings, creating a strong and unique brand voice, complemented by a clean sans-serif for body text.
A consistent, earthy color palette of dark forest green, warm beige, and a vibrant lime green accent is used to evoke a natural, fresh, and premium feel.
Content sections reveal with subtle slide-up and fade-in animations as they enter the viewport, often with a staggered effect for multiple elements within a section.
Alternating background colors (dark green, light green, beige, white) are used for full-bleed sections to clearly delineate content blocks and add visual rhythm down the page.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid dark green background with a slight height reduction as the user scrolls, maintaining a sticky position at the top.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements subtly slide up and fade into view as they enter the viewport, often with a staggered effect for multiple items within a section, likely leveraging CSS keyframes.
The hero features a full-bleed background video that plays automatically and scrolls with the page content, providing dynamic visual interest without being a fixed background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, distinctive display headings (up to ~4-5x body text) are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and image containers, maintaining a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a comfortable reading experience.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a custom, bold, rounded display typeface for all major headings, combined with a vibrant, earthy color palette and playful, hand-drawn illustrations, creates a unique brand personality that feels both premium and approachable. The integration of the oversized 'GRAZA' logo as a scrolling background element is also a memorable design choice.
